title: Notes Import Preflight
user: A person moving years of notes between tools who needs to measure what content, attachments, links, and metadata will survive before committing to an import.
smallest_useful_product: Local CLI that inventories an export archive, reports counts/types/attachment sizes/link targets, samples conversion-risk features, and compares a destination export for loss.
success_measure: For supported export fixtures, it finds 100% of intentionally missing attachments and reports notebook/note counts before a destination import is started.
constraints: Run locally; parsers must treat archives as untrusted; do not bypass application encryption or scrape accounts; preserve only aggregate diagnostics by default.
